svg.aria-label: Austempering versus quench and temper schematic
svg.title: Austempering versus quench and temper schematic
svg.text: Austempering vs quench-and-temper on a TTT diagram (schematic redraw of D4-s10, not to scale)
Austempering: rapid cool into a salt bath in the bainite range (400-800 °F, lecture), hold, no reheating for tempering.
The source draws separate centre and surface cooling curves for each route; only one curve is drawn here.
